verdict.rationale: Phaser docs and GitHub state games can be "compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native apps using 3rd party tools," covering mobile and desktop export paths, and a community report confirms a real Android .apk export at 60fps. However, there is no evidence—vendor or community—of console export capability (directly or via a documented console partner program), which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: documented console export path or partner program, first-party tooling/guide for desktop/mobile builds beyond "3rd party tools", independent confirmation of Steam/iOS builds.
